نتدربس (form IIq)
# نَتَدَرْبَسُ (natadarbasu) /na.ta.dar.ba.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَدَرْبَسَ (tadarbasa)
# نَتَدَرْبَسَ (natadarbasa) /na.ta.dar.ba.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَدَرْبَسَ (tadarbasa)
# نَتَدَرْبَسْ (natadarbas) /na.ta.dar.bas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَدَرْبَسَ (tadarbasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
